name: Emergency hotfix
purpose: Restore service quickly with the minimum change, keeping review and approval, then audit afterwards.
trigger: A Sev1 or Sev2 production incident whose fix needs a code change that cannot wait for the normal release.
entry_criteria: Incident declared with an incident commander
Mitigation without code (flag, rollback, scaling) was considered and is insufficient or unavailable

steps.note: Know the way back before changing production.
Compressed to the changed lines; never skipped.
Expedited change approval by the on-call change authority.

decisions.question: Does mitigation without code restore service?

failure_paths.condition: New test fails or cannot be written in the time box
failure_paths.action: Escalate to the incident commander; prefer rollback over an untested fix

failure_paths.condition: Approval not granted within the time box
failure_paths.action: Do not deploy; commander chooses rollback or another mitigation

exit_criteria: Service restored and held stable for the agreed observation window
Fix back-ported to the main branch
communication_plan: Incident commander posts status at a fixed interval to stakeholders; customer communication follows the incident-response plan.
